Package com.egradx.auth.account

Class EgradxInvitationService

java.lang.Object
com.egradx.auth.account.EgradxInvitationService
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.springframework.beans.factory.Aware, org.springframework.context.ApplicationEventPublisherAware
public class EgradxInvitationService extends Object implements org.springframework.context.ApplicationEventPublisherAware
Invitations to join an organization, by email.

An organization admin invites an address with a role; the link emailed there lets the person join. Someone new picks a name and password and their account is created. Someone who already has an account — in another organization — must be signed in as that account to accept, so a leaked link never adds a stranger's session to anyone's account.

There is at most one pending invitation per organization and address: inviting again replaces it (new role, new link — the old one stops working). The link is sent inside the transaction that stores it, so an invitation exists only if its email was queued.

    • accept

      @Transactional public EgradxAuthResult accept(String token, UUID signedInUserId, EgradxAcceptInvitationRequest request)
      Accepts an invitation and signs the person into that organization.

      If the invited address already has an account, the caller must be signed in as it (signedInUserId); the account simply gains a membership. Otherwise a new account is created from request's name and password, and whoever might be signed in is irrelevant.

      Throws:
      AuthorizationException - INVITATION_SIGN_IN_REQUIRED, INVITATION_EMAIL_MISMATCH, ORG_SUSPENDED
      DuplicateResourceException - INVITATION_ALREADY_ACCEPTED, INVITATION_ALREADY_MEMBER
      NotFoundException - INVITATION_INVALID
      ValidationException - INVITATION_EXPIRED, PASSWORD_INVALID, a missing name
